purpose: Freeze the bounded inference REST and streaming-response journeys used by the io-http-v1 P1 gate before qualification.
common_setup_outside_measurement: one long-lived asynchronous runtime with one dedicated event worker per route
one complete warmup episode per workload and execution order

common_semantics.transport: a fresh nonblocking Unix socket pair with identical 4 KiB send and receive buffers for each charged connection episode
common_semantics.request: sequential keep-alive HTTP/1.1 POST /v1/completions with Content-Length and an application/json body retained and byte-validated by the server
common_semantics.response: HTTP/1.1 200 keep-alive response with text/event-stream and application-sized chunked writes
common_semantics.consumption: the client incrementally decodes every response body into a bounded 8 KiB view and validates every byte
common_semantics.progress: one external owner admits both endpoints to one persistent dedicated worker and synchronously waits for their typed completion
common_semantics.failure: any framing, status, body, keep-alive or completion mismatch invalidates the process

route_specific_implementation.hyle: public Scheduler, IoContext, TcpStream and io_http owning connection/body reader/body writer APIs
route_specific_implementation.boost_beast: public Boost.Asio io_context/local stream and Boost.Beast parser, serializer and chunk APIs
route_specific_implementation.interpretation: parser, coroutine representation, allocation and connection-state costs are natural product-route outputs; the result answers HTTP-factor non-inferiority on the fixed local byte transport, not TCP-stack or raw-parser superiority

workloads.consumer: a warm keep-alive inference REST connection carrying small JSON requests and token-stream response fragments
charged_phases: per-connection HTTP state construction and retirement
128 complete request head serializations and parses
128 retained and validated 1 KiB request bodies
128 response heads and 1024 application-sized chunk writes
incremental response decoding and exact validation

workloads.consumer: a holdout inference request/response episode whose body is much larger than the socket buffers
charged_phases: per-connection HTTP state construction and retirement
16 complete request head serializations and parses
16 retained and validated 64 KiB request bodies through partial transport progress
16 response heads and 256 application-sized chunk writes
incremental response decoding and exact validation

negative_space: raw picohttpparser and blocking socket rows are diagnostic-only
TLS handshakes and encryption are owned and qualified by io_tls
listener accept, routing, authentication, model schema, batching and handler-pool policy are not HTTP-factor work
the convenience HttpBodySource adapter is a correctness and usability route; the same-contract performance gate measures identical manual application chunk production on both sides
